index 25c3b44250..0604954558 100644
--- a/django/utils/autoreload.py
+++ b/django/utils/autoreload.py
@@ -139,9 +139,10 @@ def iter_modules_and_files(modules, extra_files):
         path = Path(filename)
         try:
             resolved_path = path.resolve(strict=True).absolute()
-        except FileNotFoundError:
+        except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):
             # The module could have been removed, don't fail loudly if this
-            # is the case.
+            # is the case. Also, some paths may contain null bytes which
+            # cause ValueError when resolving symlinks.
             continue
         results.add(resolved_path)
     return frozenset(results)
@@ -187,7 +188,9 @@ def sys_path_directories():
         path = Path(path)
         try:
             resolved_path = path.resolve(strict=True).absolute()

+        except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):
+            # The path may not exist or may contain null bytes which cause
+            # ValueError when resolving symlinks.
             continue
         # If the path is a file (like a zip file), watch the parent directory.
         if resolved_path.is_file():
